name: FINIS Freestyler paddle with skeg
description: The specialist. Its elongated shape and bottom skeg act like a keel — cross over your centerline on entry and the paddle tracks crooked so you feel the error instantly.

name: FINIS Long Floating Fins for beginners
description: The exception to the short-blade rule, and the fin nearly every swimmer starts on. The extra length and float give true beginners the propulsion and flotation to learn the kicking motion.

name: FINIS Agility strapless swim paddles
description: The smartest paddle on the market — no strap, just a thumb hole, so it only stays on if you keep constant pressure on the water with a proper catch. Go lazy and it falls off.

name: Speedo Team Pull Buoy
description: The bulk-bin workhorse — cheap, durable, and perfectly functional. It survives being thrown in a bag, stepped on, and left in a hot car all summer, which is why clubs buy it by the dozen.
